### v27.0.0-alpha.0.1.0 (Alpha) - 2026-11-12

- Various documentation updates and benchmark additions.

- Updated dependencies including brotli, llhttp, sqlite, and undici.

- Similar security fixes as v26.13.1 release for http2, tls, http and permission modules.  
- Dependency updates to brotli, llhttp, sqlite, and undici.
